scope: Synthetic full SQLite MemoryLedger.reconcile temporal-sibling CPU cost on three fixed1600-entry layouts; exact output/read-only contracts; no models/tokens/billing/task-quality or universal speedup

implementation.procedure: Read baseline git139ae9e1 and candidate project_memory temporal section; actual frozen source hashes and paths, SQL/snapshot/refusal unaffected; inspect runner and benchmark timing boundaries.
implementation.acceptance: Only reviewed in-place section/import changes; no hidden policy/schema/backend effects.

reference_boundary.procedure: Read literal cases, deterministic seed609 pairwise oracle, duplicate-ID self exclusion, empty/tied/overlap cases; independently invoke frozen test suite once.
reference_boundary.acceptance: All assertions and existing four module contracts pass; output order, exact counts and native CLI refusal preserved.

data_integrity.procedure: Verify every frozen file/fixture/schema/output hash, admission count, raw five samples each of three layouts and code identity; preserve every failed/negative output.
data_integrity.acceptance: Exactly one baseline/fixed/independent; five samples/layout; equal input/output/schema hashes and unmodified database hashes, no omitted failures.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Independently recompute medians and fixed/baseline ratios from raw samples, verify finite positive seconds, count bounds and exact expected rows.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: All samples positive finite, medians/ratios exact within display rounding; count bounds match independent reference.

measurement_validity.procedure: Check full reconcile API timer includes SQLite hydration and JSON-budget construction, excludes fixture/hash/oracle; same Python/platform/sqlite and declared shared host, no warmups/retries/affinity change.
measurement_validity.acceptance: Producer fixed median<=0.70baseline for shared/overlap and<=1.25unique-common; otherwise negative hypothesis only, no optimization publication. Timing supports finite synthetic scope only, no significance/general claim.

reproducibility.procedure: Reviewer reads actual frozen source/inputs/rawdata and runs the single independent fixed suite+benchmark within same900s admission.
reproducibility.acceptance: Independent correctness passes and exact fixture/schema/output identities match; all independent medians satisfy same ratio thresholds against frozen producer baseline; no new baseline or repeats.
